evidence.claim: The card has paid the same $30.91 (±$0.15, product W, same region) on 2 earlier days: 2016-08-28, 2016-11-25

Billing region 494 is routine for this card: purchases there on 17 different days before — bank memory: less reassuring than it looks: 60% of 76 past model alerts with this signal were fraud (vs 29% without), so here it counts for little
Bank model scored the transaction 0.55 (treated as a weak input: above 0.7 most alerts are legitimate)
Assumed response to customer_validation: Customer confirms they made the transaction

Retrieved guidance applied: Out-of-region use: card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in while normal activity continues at home. Several days of purchases in one new region is a trip, not a clone.

case.summary: The transaction of $30.91 was reviewed after a real-time model flagged it with a score of 0.55. Evidence showed the card had made the same purchase on two earlier dates and that billing region 494 is routine for this card, while the model score was a weak input. Customer validation was requested and the customer confirmed they made the transaction. Based on the low fraud probability and the confirmation, the transaction was allowed and the case was closed as legitimate.
